description: Replace the Midtrans/QR online payment with a MANUAL payment flow using dummy bank details. Two methods chosen at checkout: (1) bank_transfer — show dummy kost bank details from config + amount due, customer uploads a proof-of-transfer image; (2) on_site — pay directly on site, no upload. After submit, the booking goes to the awaiting-verification state (reuse status 'review') and a Payment row records the method. No Midtrans credentials or calls on the required path. Depends on FEAT-001 only for a working logged-in customer in the e2e assertions; the code changes here are independent. See context.json verification_findings.midtrans and .payments_table.
steps: Create config/payment.php returning ['bank' => ['name' => env('KOST_BANK_NAME', 'Bank Central Asia (BCA)'), 'account_number' => env('KOST_BANK_ACCOUNT_NUMBER', '1234567890'), 'account_holder' => env('KOST_BANK_ACCOUNT_HOLDER', 'Arca Kost Dummy')]]. Dummy fallbacks must be present so config works even if .env is not read.
Append to .env AND .env.example (do NOT touch DB_* keys): KOST_BANK_NAME="Bank Central Asia (BCA)", KOST_BANK_ACCOUNT_NUMBER="1234567890", KOST_BANK_ACCOUNT_HOLDER="Arca Kost Dummy".

Create migration database/migrations/<timestamp>_add_verification_fields_to_payments_table.php adding nullable verified_at (timestamp) and notes (string) to payments. Do NOT change the status enum (pending|success|failed) and do NOT touch the bookings CHECK constraint.

Rework app/Http/Controllers/BookingController.php@pay: pass bank details from config('payment.bank') to the view instead of hardcoded values; remove the QrCode generation from the required path (you may delete the SimpleSoftwareIO QrCode use for this flow). Keep the owner-only 403 guard and $booking->load('room.roomType').

Rework resources/views/booking/payment.blade.php: present exactly two radio options for name=payment_method with values 'bank_transfer' and 'on_site'. For bank_transfer show bank name / account number / account holder (from the view vars) + amount due and the proof-upload file input (name=payment_receipt, accept image/*). For on_site show a short note and NO upload. Update the existing inline JS to show/hide the upload section based on selection. Remove the QR image block and the 'qr' radio.

Rework app/Http/Controllers/BookingController.php@processCheckout: validate payment_method in:bank_transfer,on_site; for bank_transfer validate payment_receipt required|image|mimes:jpg,jpeg,png|max:4096, store on the 'public' disk under 'proofs/', delete any prior proof, and save the path to bookings.proof_of_payment; for on_site require no upload. In BOTH cases create a Payment (booking_id, amount = booking->total_price, payment_method = chosen, status = 'pending') and set booking status = 'review'. Remove the old 'qr' branch. Keep the owner-only 403 guard. No Midtrans calls.
Leave BookingPageController@store and @extend as-is (they already create bookings with status 'pending' and redirect to booking.pay).
acceptance_criteria: config('payment.bank.account_number') returns '1234567890' after config:clear even without reading .env.
GET /booking/{booking}/pay as the booking owner returns 200 and renders the dummy bank account number and both payment methods; no QR/Midtrans is required.

POST /booking/{booking}/checkout with payment_method=bank_transfer and a fake image sets booking.status='review', stores the proof on the public disk, saves bookings.proof_of_payment, and creates a Payment row (payment_method='bank_transfer', status='pending').
POST /booking/{booking}/checkout with payment_method=on_site sets booking.status='review' and creates a Payment row (payment_method='on_site', status='pending') with no proof required.
`php artisan migrate` runs clean on pgsql and `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed` still succeeds.
verification: php artisan config:clear && php artisan tinker --execute="echo config('payment.bank.account_number');"
findings: Implemented manual payment flow, no Midtrans on required path. Changes: (1) Created config/payment.php returning ['bank' => ['name','account_number','account_holder']] with env() + dummy fallbacks (BCA / 1234567890 / Arca Kost Dummy). (2) Appended KOST_BANK_NAME, KOST_BANK_ACCOUNT_NUMBER, KOST_BANK_ACCOUNT_HOLDER to both .env and .env.example; DB_* keys untouched. (3) Added migration 2026_06_15_000003_add_verification_fields_to_payments_table.php adding nullable timestamp verified_at (after status) and nullable string notes (after verified_at); status enum and bookings CHECK constraint untouched. (4) BookingController@pay now reads bank details from config('payment.bank'), removed QrCode generation and the SimpleSoftwareIO\QrCode\Facades\QrCode use; kept owner-only 403 guard and $booking->load('room.roomType'); added use App\Models\Payment. (5) resources/views/booking/payment.blade.php: two radio options for name=payment_method — 'bank_transfer' (default checked, shows bank name/account/holder + amount due + proof-upload file input name=payment_receipt accept=image/*) and 'on_site' (short note, no upload). Removed QR image block and 'qr' radio; inline JS now toggles bank-details/on-site-details/proof-upload sections and initialises from the pre-checked option. (6) BookingController@processCheckout: validates payment_method in:bank_transfer,on_site; for bank_transfer validates payment_receipt required|image|mimes:jpg,jpeg,png|max:4096, deletes any prior proof, stores under proofs/ on public disk, saves bookings.proof_of_payment; on_site requires no upload. In both cases creates a Payment row (booking_id, amount=total_price, payment_method=chosen, status='pending') and sets booking status='review'. Removed old 'qr' branch; kept owner-only 403 guard; no Midtrans. BookingPageController left as-is. VERIFICATION: php artisan config:clear then config('payment.bank.account_number') echoed '1234567890' (green). php artisan migrate ran clean on pgsql (new migration DONE). php artisan test: 21 passed, 4 failed — the 4 failures (Auth\PasswordResetTest x3, ExampleTest) are PRE-EXISTING and unrelated (all 'no such table: reviews' on sqlite :memory:; confirmed by git stash: ExampleTest still fails without my changes). None of my touched files are involved in those failures. No new tests existed for the payment flow (grep found none).
